decisions: Record Binance's top-ten XRP coverage as a company assertion at the 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC snapshot; full zk-SNARK proof remains pending.
Do not convert aggregate 90% recovery coverage, the remaining 10%, or the prior USD 6.34B reserve plan into XRP-specific market demand.
Keep SAFU, Futures Insurance Fund, corporate treasury, customer custody, spot/OTC purchases and issuer-frozen stablecoins as separate balance categories.
Record the SBI VISA Crypto Card as a confirmed XRP-selectable retail distribution mechanism, but not as evidence of open-market purchases.
Separate the current September–October campaign from the expired May–August launch campaign; current application cutoff is 2026-10-31 JST.
Treat SBI VC Trade's displayed sales-price reference as a reward calculation input, not an execution record.
Treat SBI/Visa MOU as exploratory; SBI VC Trade/Ripple RLUSD listing as a distinct stablecoin relationship.
Treat Coinbase offline-key changes as a custody response, not XRP demand.
Keep the fixed-horizon ledger as a measurement foundation; no trained model, walk-forward skill or calibrated forecast is claimed.
required_verification: Obtain Binance's full zk-SNARK proof and October 31 address/liability export by the announced November 3 estimate.
Crosswalk the five XRPL incident source wallets and receiver against the new Binance XRP reserve set.
Reconcile XRP-specific purchases, reward credits and OTC sourcing only from executed or independently corroborated evidence.
Trace SBI card reward credits and deposit-voucher redemptions if aggregate public data becomes available.
Resolve derivatives contract universes and implement leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation before any prediction.
